classification.difficultyReason: Choose and orient an auxiliary parallel using the taught construction method, transfer angles to the target vertex, and decide whether to add, subtract or use a straight angle or revolution; part d also requires converting the reflex angle before separating its components.

content.prompt: Copy each diagram below, then add a suitable construction line in order to find the size of the marked angle $\angle VOW$. The construction line has been drawn for you in the first one. Give careful reasons for all your statements.

spec.description: Two marked parallel ascending lines, joined by OV and OW. The supplied red dashed ray OX is parallel to them.
spec.mathematics: A,V,B and C,W,D are collinear; AB parallel CD parallel OX; angle AVO=60 degrees; angle CWO=50 degrees; find angle VOW.

answer.short:
$110^\circ$.

Use the supplied parallel construction and angles at a point.
answer.worked:
$OX\parallel AB\parallel CD$ is supplied.

$\angle VOX+60^\circ=180^\circ$ (co-interior angles, $AB\parallel OX$), so $\angle VOX=120^\circ$.

$\angle XOW+50^\circ=180^\circ$ (co-interior angles, $CD\parallel OX$), so $\angle XOW=130^\circ$.

Angles at $O$ add to $360^\circ$:
$$\begin{align*}\angle VOW&=360^\circ-120^\circ-130^\circ\\\angle VOW&=110^\circ.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallel horizontal PV and QW with bent side VOW; the left sector at O is marked.
spec.mathematics: PV parallel QW; angle PVO=100 degrees; angle QWO=125 degrees.

answer.short:
$135^\circ$.

Construct a line through $O$ parallel to $PV$.
answer.worked:
Construct ray $OX$ horizontally to the left, with $OX\parallel PV\parallel QW$.

$$\begin{align*}\angle VOX&=180^\circ-100^\circ\\\angle VOX&=80^\circ\end{align*}$$
(co-interior angles, $PV\parallel OX$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle XOW&=180^\circ-125^\circ\\\angle XOW&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$
(co-interior angles, $QW\parallel OX$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle VOW&=80^\circ+55^\circ\\\angle VOW&=135^\circ\end{align*}$$
(adjacent angles at $O$).

spec.description: Leftward ray OX parallel to PV and QW, in the unchanged base coordinate frame.
spec.mathematics: The construction divides the required angle into 80 degrees and 55 degrees.

spec.description: Polyline A-B-V-O-W; no parallel arrows added because none are printed.
spec.mathematics: Angle ABV=65 degrees and angle BVO=135 degrees. The intended relationship AB parallel WO is absent from the source givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Printed givens only; missing relationship remains unresolved.

answer.worked:
Construct ray $VX\parallel AB\parallel WO$ pointing down and right inside $\angle BVO$. Then $\angle BVX=65^\circ$ (alternate angles, $AB\parallel VX$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle XVO&=135^\circ-65^\circ\\\angle XVO&=70^\circ.\end{align*}$$
Hence $\angle VOW=70^\circ$ (alternate angles, $VX\parallel WO$).

spec.description: Two upward-marked parallel verticals; H-Q-M and M-O-W are straight. The reflex sector below M is marked 300 degrees.
spec.mathematics: GQF parallel VOU; angle GQH=25 degrees; reflex angle QMO=300 degrees; find angle VOW.
spec.answerVisibility: No constructed line or answer supplied.

answer.short:
$35^\circ$.

Construct a vertical parallel through $M$ and use the non-reflex angle at $M$.
answer.worked:
Construct ray $MX$ vertically upwards, with $MX\parallel GF\parallel VU$.

$\angle QMX=25^\circ$ (corresponding angles, $MX\parallel GF$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle QMO\text{ (non-reflex)}&=360^\circ-300^\circ\\\angle QMO\text{ (non-reflex)}&=60^\circ.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\angle XMO&=60^\circ-25^\circ\\\angle XMO&=35^\circ.\end{align*}$$
Therefore $\angle VOW=35^\circ$ (corresponding angles, $MX\parallel VU$).

spec.description: CA and DB have matching arrows. C-O-W and D-O-V are straight; the marked angle is above-right at O.
spec.mathematics: CA parallel DB; angle ACO=35 degrees; angle ODB=30 degrees.

answer.short:
$65^\circ$.

Construct a parallel through $O$ and add the two component angles.
answer.worked:
Construct ray $OX$ between $OV$ and $OW$, with $OX\parallel CA\parallel DB$.

$\angle VOX=30^\circ$ (corresponding angles, $OX\parallel DB$).

$\angle XOW=35^\circ$ (corresponding angles, $OX\parallel CA$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle VOW&=30^\circ+35^\circ\\\angle VOW&=65^\circ\end{align*}$$
(adjacent angles at $O$).

spec.description: Crossing straight lines L-O-W and M-O-V; LV and MW are marked parallel.
spec.mathematics: LV parallel MW; angle VLO=21 degrees; angle OMW=31 degrees; marked right-hand angle VOW.

answer.short:
$52^\circ$.

Construct a parallel through $O$ and add the component angles.
answer.worked:
Construct ray $OX$ to the right, with $OX\parallel LV\parallel MW$.

$\angle VOX=31^\circ$ (corresponding angles, $OX\parallel MW$).

$\angle XOW=21^\circ$ (corresponding angles, $OX\parallel LV$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle VOW&=31^\circ+21^\circ\\\angle VOW&=52^\circ\end{align*}$$
(adjacent angles at $O$).

spec.description: Rightward ray OX parallel to LV and MW.
spec.mathematics: The construction divides angle VOW into 31 degrees and 21 degrees.

spec.description: Parallel steep segments FU and GV; U-O-W is straight and OV joins the bend to V.
spec.mathematics: FU parallel GV; angle FUO=150 degrees; angle GVO=132 degrees.

answer.short:
$102^\circ$.

Construct a parallel through $O$, then use a straight angle.
answer.worked:
Construct ray $OX$ upwards and left, with $OX\parallel UF\parallel VG$.

$$\begin{align*}\angle UOX&=180^\circ-150^\circ\\\angle UOX&=30^\circ\end{align*}$$
(co-interior angles, $UF\parallel OX$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle XOV&=180^\circ-132^\circ\\\angle XOV&=48^\circ\end{align*}$$
(co-interior angles, $VG\parallel OX$).

Since $U,O,W$ lie on a straight line,
$$\begin{align*}\angle VOW&=180^\circ-30^\circ-48^\circ\\\angle VOW&=102^\circ.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Ray OX parallel to UF and VG.
spec.mathematics: The straight angle UOW contains components 30 degrees, 48 degrees and the required angle.

spec.description: AB and V-W-M are marked parallel. A-W-O is straight. The 20-degree leader points to the angle at V, not the angle at O.
spec.mathematics: AB parallel VM; angle BAO=70 degrees; angle WVO=20 degrees; find angle VOW.

answer.short:
$50^\circ$.

Construct a parallel through $O$ and subtract the transferred $20^\circ$ angle.
answer.worked:
Construct ray $OX$ upwards and left, with $OX\parallel AB\parallel VM$.

$\angle WOX=70^\circ$ (alternate angles, $AB\parallel OX$).

$\angle XOV=20^\circ$ (alternate angles, $VM\parallel OX$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle VOW&=70^\circ-20^\circ\\\angle VOW&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
(adjacent angles at $O$).

spec.description: Upward-left ray OX parallel to AB and VM.
spec.mathematics: Angle WOX is 70 degrees and contains angle XOV of 20 degrees and the required 50-degree angle.
